messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content: Here are some fun true or false questions to introduce a new teacher to your students. 楽しい ones build excitement and break the ice before the teacher even says a single word of 自己紹介. Here are five great options for you to pick from in your class. Each one sparks 好奇心. Let students vote before revealing answers. This builds excitement and gives you a perfect moment for 笑い and fun stories. Keep questions light and positive so every student feels welcome and ready to 楽しむ. Sample questions include: Did the teacher ever win a school talent show? True or false? Let's 始める. The teacher's favorite food is 寿司. True or false? The teacher speaks three languages. True or 嘘. The teacher has visited more than ten countries. True or false? The teacher's childhood nickname was 面白い. True or false?
